I have grown beans on this rented plot for many years, and I know the soil here needs some help. I will apply DAP fertilizer from the cooperative and also spread cow manure that I have saved from my animals, because beans still need phosphorus even if they fix their own nitrogen. I will plant my own seed that I kept from last harvest, since improved bean seed is hard to find in our area and too costly. My children and I will do most of the work, but I will hire a few day laborers when the weeds come thick and during harvest so we do not lose crop to late rains.
